thread:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — running an early-look interview series for 6 pilot seats next week to surface setup friction and feature gaps. Need enrollments, a short micro-survey, and folks to join calls for notes and follow-ups.
Ajay (PM): Proposed slots Tue/Wed 10-11am PT. Can ENG join for live infra Qs? @Kelly (SE) can you take Wed?
Kelly (SE): I can do Wed 10am PT. I'll bring a short onboarding checklist and link to the internal runbook: https://redwood.ai/onboard/checklist. Will paste the snippet here before the call.
Dorian (Research): For capture, let's use an 8-question micro-survey + a 40-min call rubric. I'll drop the form + the call script in the thread. Survey: https://forms.redwood.com/early-look?pid=EL-2025
Maria (CS): Plan for the session: 15m intro, 15m product walkthrough, 20m structured feedback (10m survey+10m open). Post-call: send Loom + survey. Owners: Maria = invites & loom, Kelly = SSO doc, Dorian = survey results, Ajay = compile highlights + tag renewal-risk signals.
Kelly (SE): I'll own SSO Qs & quick remediation checklist. Note for Okta/SCIM customers: set `scim.enabled=true` in onboarding YAML to prevent duplicate accounts. Snippet: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true`
Ajay (PM): Can someone hit record? If we surface activation friction we'll capture CTAs and create eng tickets. Also capture a 1-5 "likelihood to recommend" and mark any "deal-breaker" infra items.
OnboardBot: Calendar event created: Early Look Interviews — Wed 2025-06-18 10:00 PT. Attendees: Maria, Ajay, Kelly, Dorian. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/earlylook-xxx
Maria (CS): Need two volunteers for note-taking + one person to triage renewal-risk flags (SSO blockers, data residency concerns, throughput/latency complaints). I'll DM the cohort roster once seats confirm.
Kelly (SE): I'll prepare a 2-slide "Known issues & workarounds" deck and share it prior to the call. Also will include the minimal config fixes we commonly push.
Dorian (Research): Call script highlights: 3 rapid onboarding tasks, 2 perf probes (sample logs), then the 8-question micro-survey. I'll share the rubric here after this message.
Ajay (PM): If we see infra deal-breakers, we tag as P0 and route to runtime oncall. We'll need an owner to confirm the customer can be unblocked within the trial window.
Maria (CS): OK — I'll post the roster + invite in ~30m and create a follow-up checklist. If anyone else wants to join for live Qs, ping me. :sparkles:
Kelly (SE): One more note — provisioning helm chart sometimes requires `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` for internal air-gapped demos. I'll include the snippet in the doc.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone. Post-call deliverables: Loom + survey to participants within 24h, compile top 3 friction points, map to potential quick wins vs product backlog items.
Ajay (PM): Sounds good. I'll make the backlog template and include an "activation urgency" field (low/med/high).
Dorian (Research): I'll export the survey results to CSV and tag quotes for CS handoff.
Maria (CS): Final: dropping a short checklist of what I need from each owner in a follow-up message.
